natural_body: Targeted 40% discounts boost acquisition but sharply damage retention.

first.rationale: Current situation shows both activation and onboarding completion declining (6% and 4% respectively). Memory_31 and memory_86 together demonstrate that simplifying onboarding has delivered durable activation gains in the past, directly addressing both metrics we're seeing decline. Verifying these will confirm whether the effect sizes still hold and whether there are implementation details relevant to the current environment. This approach avoids the retention damage from promotional_pricing (memory_73) while targeting the root cause of the activation drop. It also fits our primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue over chasing price-sensitive SMB with discounts. Referral incentives (memory_57) work well for retention but don't address the acquisition/activation squeeze directly. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the SMB competitive threat. We have one slot; simplifying onboarding tackles both observed metrics simultaneously.
